arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Laalish{/c} also {c_important}{u}Weakens{/u}{/c} enemies. {c_important}Laalish{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} enemies.

When {c_important}Laalish{/c} kills an enemy or when an enemy is {c_important}{u}Executed{/u}{/c}, the Cooldown of {c_important}Command Laalish{/c} is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_1}|1|]{/c} seconds.
